name: SOSA ObservationCollection Feature
abstract: OMS alignment: implements the ISO 19156:2023 (OGC Topic 20 / O&M 3.0) `obs-basic/ObservationCollection` requirement class for `sosa:ObservationCollection`. This building blocks defines an ObservationCollection Feature according to the SOSA/SSN v1.1 specification.

sources.title: Extensions to the Semantic Sensor Network Ontology

transforms.description:
Flattens a (possibly nested) SOSA ObservationCollection GeoJSON document into a
plain GeoJSON FeatureCollection of Observation Features. Each output Feature's
`properties` merges in every property inherited from its containing
ObservationCollection(s) - the nearest collection wins on conflicting keys. If a
Feature has no geometry of its own, one is taken from the `geometry` of its own
`hasFeatureOfInterest`, or - failing that - from the nearest ancestor collection's
`hasFeatureOfInterest` that carries a geometry.

examples.title: Example of SOSA ObservationCollection
examples.comment: This class is a target for the SOSA v 1.1 update.

examples.title: Example of nested SOSA ObservationCollections with an inline Feature of Interest geometry
examples.comment:
An ObservationCollection Feature's `features` array can itself contain nested
ObservationCollection Features, not just individual Observations - a
FeatureCollection cannot appear as a `features` member, so each nested
collection is a `Feature` whose members are held in `properties.hasMember`
rather than a further `features` array. Common properties are held at the
level of the collection that shares them, rather than repeated on every
member: the outer collection declares `resultTime` and an inline
`hasFeatureOfInterest` (with a sample `Point` geometry) shared by every
observation in the whole tree; each inner sub-collection declares its own
`observedProperty`, shared only by its own member observations, which in
turn carry nothing but their individual `phenomenonTime` and result.
